sourceTitle: A Practical Enquiry into the Philosophy of Education
description: "A Practical Enquiry into the Philosophy of Education" by James Gall is an educational treatise written in the early 19th century. The work aims to explore and establish foundational principles for the science and art of education, emphasizing the significance of understanding how nature instructs and cultivates young minds.
